previewSaveHint: Preview is visual. Save settings to apply changes to printed documents.

invoiceSettings.title: Invoice Settings
invoiceSettings.subtitle: Configure receipt and invoice appearance
invoiceSettings.businessIdentityHelp: Brand name and logo used on printed documents
invoiceSettings.displayNameHelp: Optional. Replaces the business name in invoice headers. The legal business name remains in the QR code.
invoiceSettings.logoHelp: PNG or JPG, recommended 200×200 px, maximum 2 MB
invoiceSettings.logoUploadHelp: PNG, JPG, or WebP. Maximum 2 MB. Save settings after uploading to apply this logo.
invoiceSettings.logoPendingSave: Logo uploaded. Save settings to keep it on this branch.
invoiceSettings.contactDetailsHelp: Optional contact information for invoices and receipts
invoiceSettings.emailHelp: Shown on invoices when Show Email is enabled
invoiceSettings.websiteHelp: Shown on invoices when Show Website is enabled. Plain domains are saved with https://.
invoiceSettings.websiteHint: You can enter example.com; it will be saved as https://example.com.
invoiceSettings.optionalFieldsHelp: Choose which saved details appear on printed documents
invoiceSettings.cashChangeHelp: Print the change amount on cash receipts
invoiceSettings.footerMessageHelp: Printed at the bottom of thermal and A4 documents
invoiceSettings.footerTextHelp: Custom message printed at the bottom when Show Footer is enabled
invoiceSettings.footerPlaceholder: e.g. Thank you for your business! Visit again.
invoiceSettings.footerShortHint: Keep it short for thermal receipts.
invoiceSettings.defaultPrintActionHelp: Controls the actions shown after checkout. Direct printing uses the thermal receipt format.
invoiceSettings.thermalReceiptHelp: Show the receipt print action after sale
invoiceSettings.a4InvoiceHelp: Show the A4 invoice print action after sale
invoiceSettings.bothActionsHelp: Show receipt and A4 invoice actions
invoiceSettings.fixFields: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
invoiceSettings.futurePrints: Saved settings apply to future prints and reprints.
invoiceSettings.websiteInvalid: Enter a valid website, such as example.com.
invoiceSettings.phoneInvalid: Use 7–50 digits or phone symbols only.
invoiceSettings.footerTooLong: Footer must be {{count}} characters or fewer.
invoiceSettings.logoTypeInvalid: Upload a PNG, JPG, or WebP logo.
invoiceSettings.documentLanguageHelp: Choose the language used on new invoices, receipts, and credit notes. The preview updates immediately; save to apply it.
invoiceSettings.documentLanguageHistory: Previously issued documents keep their saved language. Older documents without a saved language follow the current branch setting.
